home.no_matches_body: Try another search or clear filters in this project.
home.trash_empty_body: Files moved to Trash will appear here.
home.project_ready_body: Open a file or create something new to add work to this project.
home.start_body: Open a photo or start a new document. Saved work will appear here.
home.cloud_files_body: Browse synced files. Open a file’s history to see older versions.
settings.title: Every tier is optional.
settings.intro: Emulsion is a complete editor with none of these. Each tier you add makes it better, and anything that needs a missing tier falls back or stays hidden.
settings.language_body: The language of menus, Home and Settings. Other screens are being translated and show English until then.
settings.layout_reuse_body: May reduce CPU use by reusing unchanged layout. Performance varies by workload; turn it off if rendering looks wrong or feels slower. Applies immediately to all windows. Your choice is saved.
settings.layout_reuse_override: A launch override will set the starting value again after restart.
settings.tier_builtin_body: Nodes, masks, blend modes, adjustments, OpenRaster and image formats, the offline request planner behind F1, and suggestions from image statistics.
settings.tier_models_body: Segmentation, subject mattes, depth, fill and upscaling that run on this machine with ONNX Runtime. Install what you want; each task's tools appear once its model is here. Select Subject and Remove Background need a matte model, the AI quick select needs SlimSAM.
settings.tier_cli_body: Multi-step requests from F1 go to a coding CLI that can only use Emulsion's tools. Every change it proposes is shown as an Apply / Skip card unless you turn on auto-apply. Claude Code asks before each tool; Codex, OpenCode and Kimi run one process per request and Emulsion holds their changes for you instead.
settings.cli_missing: %{name} was not found. Install it with: %{hint}
settings.next_session: The model picks up these settings the next time a document starts an assistant session.
settings.tier_jev_body: TypeSafe's Jev answers small typed questions with calibrated confidence. With a key, F1 requests are planned by Jev, which copes with looser phrasing than the offline planner, and only text leaves the machine: the request and layer names, never pixels.
settings.tier_shortcuts_body: Every shortcut, as it works right now. To change one, open the keymap file, uncomment a line and set its keys, then reload. Bare letters work while the canvas has focus; modifier shortcuts work anywhere.
settings.tier_image_body: Press F1 to choose Assistant, Local SD, OpenAI, or Google. Image modes create a new layer, or fill the selected area. The Select tool uses the default provider below.
settings.a1111_hint: Start A1111 / Forge with --api. Enter the base URL below.
settings.cloud_notice: Cloud generation sends your prompt and, for fills, the selected canvas context to this provider. API usage is billed separately from chat or coding subscriptions.
settings.key_accessible: Key and model accessible · %{model}. Generation quota is not checked.
settings.api_key_placeholder: Paste API key to save or replace
design.direct.select_hint: Select an object to edit it
design.direct.font_search: Search fonts and preview your text
design.background.behind_photo: This color sits behind the background photo. Remove the photo to reveal it.
design.background.preview_hint: Changes preview immediately. Done saves one undoable edit; Cancel keeps the original.
design.background.crop_hint: Page background · Drag to reposition · Scroll or +/− to zoom
design.arrange.title: Align & space
design.arrange.tidy_hint: Tidy up equalizes gaps along the wider spread of object centers. Keeps sizes and order; no automatic layout is added.
design.arrange.gaps_hint: Spacing keeps the selected outer bounds. Objects may overlap if there is not enough room.
design.arrange.busy: Finish the current edit to align or space objects.
design.arrange.locked: Unlock the selected objects and their contents to arrange them.
design.arrange.select_one: Select an object to align it to the canvas.
design.arrange.select_two: Select at least two objects to align them to each other.
design.arrange.select_three: Select at least three objects for equal gaps or Tidy up.
design.arrange.no_bounds: The selection includes an object with no artwork bounds.
design.arrange.changed: The page or selection changed. Open Align & space again.
design.resize.title: Resize page
design.resize.unchanged: Preview only. Your page stays unchanged until you apply.
design.resize.uses_anchors: Objects use their saved resize anchors. Check the preview before applying.
design.resize.dirty: Size changed. Preview again before applying.
design.resize.safe_default: Make a copy keeps the original page. Resize this page can be undone in one step.
design.resize.stale: The source page changed. Close this preview and open Resize again.
design.resize.finish_edit: Finish the current edit before resizing.
design.resize.unavailable: The editor is no longer available.
design.resize.invalid: Enter valid width, height and resolution values.
design.resize.original_size: Choose a different size to resize.
design.resize.text_overflow: %{count} text object(s) exceed their text box
design.resize.photo_gap: %{count} photo frame(s) may have uncovered areas
design.resize.check_clear: No geometric overflow found. Review text and photo crops visually.
design.resize.check_scope: Coverage checks use image bounds; transparent pixels and visual balance still need your review.
design.resize.copy_done: Created a resized copy. The original page is unchanged.
design.resize.current_done: Resized this page. Undo restores its previous size.
design.resize.review: Review the selected objects before exporting.
design.resize.print_hint: Print sizes use physical units and resolution; exported pixels are rounded to the nearest pixel.
design.resize.screen_hint: Named screen sizes are common starting points; check your destination’s requirements.
design.resize.background_crop: The background photo was refitted to cover the new page. Review its crop.
